parameters.sqlQuery:
SELECT l.client_id, l.list_kind, l.list_id
FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.ref.clickup_lists` l
JOIN `oneeighty-warehouse.ref.clients` c USING (client_id)
WHERE l.active AND c.status = 'active'
ORDER BY l.client_id, l.list_kind

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(
  ARRAY(
    SELECT AS STRUCT CONCAT(client_id, '|', task_id) AS k,
      MAX_BY(CONCAT(IFNULL(CAST(UNIX_MILLIS(date_updated) AS STRING), ''), '|', list_id), ingested_at) AS s
    FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.raw.raw_clickup_tasks`
    WHERE snapshot_date = CURRENT_DATE()
    GROUP BY client_id, task_id
  ) AS tasks,
  ARRAY(
    SELECT AS STRUCT CONCAT(client_id, '|', list_id, '|', field_id) AS k,
      MAX_BY(CONCAT(IFNULL(name, ''), '|', IFNULL(type, ''), '|', IFNULL(target_list_id, ''), '|', IFNULL(options_json, '')), ingested_at) AS s
    FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.raw.raw_clickup_fields`
    WHERE snapshot_date = CURRENT_DATE()
    GROUP BY client_id, list_id, field_id
  ) AS fields
)) AS state

WITH t AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.raw.raw_clickup_tasks`
  WHERE snapshot_date = DATE(@snapshot_date) AND ingested_at = TIMESTAMP(@ingested_at)
), f AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.raw.raw_clickup_fields`
  WHERE snapshot_date = DATE(@snapshot_date) AND ingested_at = TIMESTAMP(@ingested_at)
), i AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNTIF(severity = 'error') AS e
  FROM `oneeighty-warehouse.ops.clickup_sync_issues`
  WHERE DATE(synced_at) >= DATE(@snapshot_date) AND synced_at >= TIMESTAMP(@started_at)
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN @list_errors != 'none'
      OR t.n < CAST(@expected_tasks AS INT64)
      OR f.n < CAST(@expected_fields AS INT64) THEN 'failure'
    WHEN @rebuild_error != 'none' OR i.e > 0 THEN 'partial'
    ELSE 'success'
  END AS status,
  t.n AS task_rows,
  CONCAT('lists=', @lists, ' tasks_seen=', @tasks_seen,
         ' task_rows=', CAST(t.n AS STRING), '/', @expected_tasks,
         ' field_rows=', CAST(f.n AS STRING), '/', @expected_fields,
         ' sync_issues=', CAST(i.n AS STRING), ' (', CAST(i.e AS STRING), ' error)',
         IF(@rebuild_error = 'none', '', CONCAT(' | sp_rebuild_creative_tags failed, raw is loaded but ref.creative_tags was not rebuilt: ', @rebuild_error)),
         IF(@list_errors = 'none', '', CONCAT(' | list_errors: ', @list_errors))) AS msg
FROM t, f, i

INSERT INTO `oneeighty-warehouse.ops.pipeline_log`
  (run_id, workflow, client_id, source, started_at, finished_at, duration_seconds, status, rows_loaded, error_msg, trigger)
VALUES (
  @run_id, 'wf_clickup_to_bigquery', NULL, 'clickup',
  TIMESTAMP(@started_at), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
  TIMESTAMP_DIFF(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), TIMESTAMP(@started_at), SECOND),
  @status, CAST(@rows AS INT64), @msg, @trigger)
